DISASSEMBLY OF PARKING BRAKE

1. REMOVE REAR DISC BRAKE ASSEMBLY
(a) Remove the two mounting bolts and remove the disc brake assembly.
(b) Suspend the disc brake so the hose is not stretched.

BR1271

2. REMOVE ROTOR DISC

Place the matchmarks on the rotor disc and rear axle shaft, and remove the rotor disc.
HINT: If the drum cannot be removed easily, return the shoe adjuster until the wheel turns freely.

Matchmarks

BR0822
